messages:
zoe-p: After the RBAC enforcement deploy, a handful of tenants reported SSO failures and mass SCIM deprovisions. Quick scan shows saml binding mismatches and some token-store unwrap errors.

zoe-p: Auth-proxy sample:
```
ERROR auth-proxy: saml: binding mismatch expected=HTTP-POST got=HTTP-Artifact tenant=lynx
WARN token-store: unwrap failed alias=wrap_old keyid=k-123 err=WRAP_KEY_NOT_FOUND
WARN scim-worker: deprov enqueue tenant=lynx svc_acc=svc-ingest cause=auth_failed
```

mike-h: Hypothesis: Two parallel issues
(1) IdP metadata moved to Artifact-only for some customers; our SP was tightened to POST-only in RBAC rollout.
(2) KMS alias rotated earlier leaving some wrapped tokens referencing old alias so token-store can't unwrap -> intermittent auth.

anya-k: Quick mitigations: enable tenant-scoped artifact fallback in auth-proxy (whitelist), requeue deprovs for affected tenants, backfill audit events for window, and run a redis scan for wrap aliases.

mike-h: Commands to run:
```
curl -s https://auth-proxy.internal/.well-known/saml-metadata | xmllint --xpath "//Binding/text()" -
kubectl exec -n infra deploy/token-store -- redis-cli --scan | grep wrap_old
./scripts/requeue-deprov.sh --tenant lynx --since 1799989000
./scripts/backfill-audit.sh --start 1799989000 --end 1799993000 --verify
```

oncall: Opening INC-179999. I'll run requeue/backfill and coordinate customer comms.

ops-bot: auth-proxy hotfix queued (2026.2.1) will enable per-tenant artifact fallback during canary.

zoe-p: Owners: Zoe=backfill & verification, Mike=auth-proxy toggle + PR, Anya=KMS/token-store sweep. Postmortem once stable. Ping here with any redis lines showing stale aliases. :thumbsup:
